exposure: Mode of delivery (Vaginal delivery vs. Cesarean section)
cohort: Placental explants were obtained from women with uncomplicated pregnancies or pregnancies complicated by gestational diabetes mellitus, who delivered via vaginal delivery or cesarean section.
finding: Placental explants from GDM pregnancies exhibited significantly reduced fatty acid oxidation capacity and increased glucose uptake compared to control placentas.
mod_finding: Placental fatty acid oxidation and glucose uptake were similar in both modes of delivery (vaginal vs. cesarean section) for both normal and GDM pregnancies, indicating that placental metabolic characteristics are not altered by the mode of delivery.
